question: The points $P$ and $Q$ have position vectors $\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k}$ and $7\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-3\hat{k}$, respectively. A point $R$ divides $PQ$ internally in the ratio $2:1$.(a) Find the position vector and coordinates of $R$.(b) Determine the scalar components of $\overrightarrow{PR}$ and $\overrightarrow{RQ}$.(c) Verify from these components that $PR\:RQ=2:1$.
explanation: (a)Let`\vec{p}=\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k},\qquad \vec{q}=7\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-3\hat{k}`Since $R$ divides $PQ$ internally in the ratio $2:1$, its position vector is`\vec{r}=\frac{2\vec{q}+\vec{p}}{3}\vec{r}=\frac{2(7\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-3\hat{k})+(\hat{i}-2\hat{j}+3\hat{k})}{3}\vec{r}=5\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}`Therefore, the coordinates of $R$ are $(5,2,-1)$.(b)`\overrightarrow{PR}=\vec{r}-\vec{p}\overrightarrow{PR}=(5-1)\hat{i}+[2-(-2)]\hat{j}+(-1-3)\hat{k}\overrightarrow{PR}=4\hat{i}+4\hat{j}-4\hat{k}`Thus, its scalar components are $4,4,-4$.Also,`\overrightarrow{RQ}=\vec{q}-\vec{r}\overrightarrow{RQ}=2\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-2\hat{k}`Thus, its scalar components are $2,2,-2$.(c)From the component forms,`\overrightarrow{PR}=2\overrightarrow{RQ}`Therefore,`PR=2RQ`Final ResultHence, $PR\:RQ=2:1$, as required.

options.A:
(a) $\vec{r}=5\hat{i}+2\hat{j}-\hat{k}$, $R=(5,2,-1)$
(b) Scalar components of $\overrightarrow{PR}$ are $(4,4,-4)$ and of $\overrightarrow{RQ}$ are $(2,2,-2)$.
(c) $\overrightarrow{PR}=2\overrightarrow{RQ}$, so $PR:RQ=2:1$.
